name: Pony Diffusion
description: Versatile model - Score tags required, then natural language comma-separated descriptions Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Generate 150-200 words with rich descriptive detail after the required score tags.
detail_expectation: Provide comprehensive character, outfit, environment, and lighting descriptions in natural language.
preferences: MUST start with: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up
Then use natural language comma-separated descriptions
NO underscores in descriptive text (only in score tags)
Clear, readable phrases not technical tags
avoid: Technical tag format instead of natural language
negative_prompt_default: score_6, score_5, score_4, worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, sketch, jpeg artifacts, blurry, simple background
platform_block:
PONY DIFFUSION FORMAT (CRITICAL):
- MUST START with exactly: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up
- After score tags, use NATURAL LANGUAGE descriptions (NO underscores)
- Comma-separated detailed phrases
- DO NOT use danbooru tag format (no long_hair, brown_eyes, etc.)
- Use readable text: "long flowing hair", "brown eyes", "red dress"
- Aim for 150-200 words of rich descriptive detail
- Example: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, a young woman with long flowing hair, intense gaze, wearing elegant red dress, soft studio lighting, professional portrait
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Pony Diffusion-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
